**************************************************************** 
* PROGRAM NAME                 : SELLCOB1                      * 
* IMPORTANT FILE               : DB2 TABLE PASSENGERS, FLIGHT  * 
* PROGRAMMER                   : KERESTES                      * 
* DATE OF WRITEN               : OCT. 2022                     * 
* TECHNOLOGY                   : CICS + COBOL + DB2            * 
**************************************************************** 
*                   PROBLEM  DEFINITION                        * 
*                                                              * 
* SEARCH A FLIGHT AND A PASSENGERS TO REALISE A SELL           * 
**************************************************************** 
* INPUT PARAMETERS:                                            * 
*                                                              * 
* CLIENTID, FLIGHTNUM, DATE, AND PASSENGERS NUMBERS            * 
**************************************************************** 
* OUTPUT PARAMETERS:                                           * 
*                                                              * 
* CALL SELLMAP2 TO FINALIZE THE SELL                           * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                  
**************************************************************** 
*                  IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.                    * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. 
 PROGRAM-ID. SELLCOB1. 
                                                                  
**************************************************************** 
*                       DATA DIVISION.                         * 
**************************************************************** 
                                                                  
 DATA DIVISION. 
                                                                  
*------------------------* 
 WORKING-STORAGE SECTION. 
*------------------------* 
***************************************************************         
*                      MAPS CICS COPY                         *         
***************************************************************         
                                                                        
 COPY SELLMS.                                                           
 COPY DFHAID.                                                           
 COPY DFHBMSCA.                                                         
                                                                        
***************************************************************         
*                       WS VARIABLES                          *         
***************************************************************         
                                                                        
 01  WS-COMMAREA                                                        
     02 WS-TRANS                    PIC X(4).                           
     02 WS-USER-ID                  PIC X(8).                           
     02 WS-FLIGHTID                 PIC 9(9).
     02 WS-CLIID                    PIC 9(6).                           
     02 WS-FNUM                     PIC X(6).                           
     02 WS-DAIR                     PIC X(3).                           
     02 WS-LAIR                     PIC X(3).                           
     02 WS-FDATE                    PIC X(10).                          
     02 WS-PASSN                    PIC 9(1).                           
     02 WS-PRICE                    PIC 9(5)V9(2).                      
     02 WS-TPRICE                   PIC 9(7)V9(2).                      
                                                                        
 01  WS-PRICEV                      PIC 9(5)V9(2).                      
 01  WS-TOTPRICE                    PIC 9(7)V9(2).                      
 
 01  EDIT-PRICE1 REDEFINES WS-PRICEV PIC $$$$9.99.                                                                       
 01  EDIT-PRICE REDEFINES WS-TOTPRICE PIC $$$$$$9.99.                   
                                                                        
 01  WS-FLAG                        PIC X VALUE 'N'.                    
 01  WS-FLAG-MOUV                   PIC X VALUE 'N'.                    
                                                                        
***************************************************************         
*                    DATE AND TIME CICS                       *         
***************************************************************         
                                                                        
 01  WS-TSTAMP                    PIC S9(15) COMP-3.                    
                                                                        
 01  WS-DATE                      PIC X(10).                            
 01  WS-TIME.                                                           
     02 WS-HOUR                   PIC 9(2).                             
     02 FILLER                    PIC X(1).                             
     02 WS-MINUTE                 PIC 9(2).                             
     02 FILLER                    PIC X(1).                             
     02 WS-SECOND                 PIC 9(2).                             
                                                                        
*****************************************************************       
*                       SQL DECLARATION                         *       
*****************************************************************       
                                                                        
     EXEC SQL                                                           
         INCLUDE FLIGHT                                                 
     END-EXEC                                                           
                                                                        
     EXEC SQL                                                           
         INCLUDE PASSENG                                                
     END-EXEC                                                           
                                                                        
     EXEC SQL                                                           
         INCLUDE SQLCA                                                  
     END-EXEC                                                           
                                                                        
*----------------*                                                      
 LINKAGE SECTION.                                                       
*----------------*                                                      
                                                                        
 01  DFHCOMMAREA.                                                       
     02 TRANSACTION     PIC X(4).                                       
     02 USER-ID         PIC X(8).       
     02 COMM-FLIGHTID   PIC 9(9).                                
                                                                        
***************************************************************         
*                      PROCEDURE DIVISION.                    *         
***************************************************************         
                                                                        
 PROCEDURE DIVISION.                                                   
                                                                       
*****************************************************************      
* MAIN-PARA.                                                    *      
*                                                               *      
* THIS PROGRAM WORKS WITH A PSEUDO-CONVERSATION METHOD.         *      
* THE MAIN PARAGRAPH SET THE PROCEDURE FLOW WHICH CONTROLS THE  *      
* SRCHLI MAP.                                                   *      
*****************************************************************      
                                                                       
 MAIN-PARA.                                                            
                                                                       
     IF EIBCALEN = 0                                                   
         PERFORM 0100-GET-DFHCOMMAREA                                  
         PERFORM 0200-GET-TIME                                         
         PERFORM 0210-GIVING-TIME                                      
         PERFORM 0310-MOVE-SPACE                                       
         PERFORM 0300-SEND-MAP                                         
         PERFORM 0400-RETURN-CICS                                      
     ELSE                                                              
         MOVE SPACE TO MSG1O                                           
         MOVE SPACE TO MSG2O                                           
         PERFORM 0500-RECEIVE-MAP                                      
         PERFORM 0100-GET-DFHCOMMAREA                                  
         PERFORM 0510-VERIFY-EIBAID                                    
         PERFORM 0610-VERIFY-SPACE                                     
                                                                       
         IF WS-FLAG = 'N'                                              
                                                                       
            PERFORM 0600-PROCESS-DATA                                  
                                                                       
         END-IF                                                        
                                                                       
         PERFORM 0200-GET-TIME                                         
         PERFORM 0210-GIVING-TIME                                      
         PERFORM 0300-SEND-MAP                                         
         PERFORM 0400-RETURN-CICS                                      
                                                                        
         MOVE 'N' TO WS-FLAG                                            
     END-IF.                                                            
                                                                        
***************************************************************         
* 0100-GET-DFHCOMMAREA                                        *         
*                                                             *         
* MOVE USER-ID FROM DFHCOMMAREA TO WS-USERID.                 *         
***************************************************************         
                                                                        
 0100-GET-DFHCOMMAREA.                                                  
                                                                        
     MOVE USER-ID TO WS-USER-ID 
     MOVE WS-USER-ID TO USERIDO                                        
     MOVE EIBTRMID TO WS-TERMINAL
     MOVE WS-TERMINAL TO TERMO
     MOVE COMM-FLIGHTID TO WS-FLIGHTID.                                       
                                                                        
***************************************************************         
* 0200-GET-TIME.                                              *         
*                                                             *         
* FOR GET THE TIME WE CAN UTILISE THE CICS METHOD OR THE COBOL*         
* METHOD IF THE FUNCTION CURRENT-TIME. BUT HERE WE CHOSE THE  *         
* THE CICS METHOD.                                            *         
***************************************************************         
                                                                        
 0200-GET-TIME.                                                         
                                                                        
     EXEC CICS                                                          
         ASKTIME                                                        
         ABSTIME(WS-TSTAMP)                                             
     END-EXEC                                                           
                                                                        
     EXEC CICS                                                          
         FORMATTIME                                                     
         ABSTIME(WS-TSTAMP)                                             
         DATESEP('/')                                                   
         DDMMYYYY(WS-DATE)                                              
     END-EXEC                                                           
                                                                        
     EXEC CICS                                                          
         FORMATTIME                                                     
         ABSTIME(WS-TSTAMP)                                             
         TIMESEP(':')                                                   
         TIME(WS-TIME)                                                  
     END-EXEC.                                                          
                                                                        
***************************************************************         
* 0210-GIVING-TIME.                                           *         
*                                                             *         
* AFTER GETTING THE TIME ITS NECESSARY TO TRANSFER THIS INFO  *         
* TO THE LOGIN MAP ITSELF                                     *         
***************************************************************         
                                                                        
 0210-GIVING-TIME.                                                      
                                                                        
     IF WS-HOUR = 23                                                    
        MOVE ZEROS TO WS-HOUR                                           
     ELSE                                                               
        ADD 1 TO WS-HOUR.                                               
     END-IF                                                             
                                                                        
     MOVE WS-TIME TO LHOURO                                             
     MOVE WS-DATE TO LDATEO.                                            
                                                                        
***************************************************************         
* 0300-SEND-MAP.                                              *         
*                                                             *         
* SEND MAP PROCEDURE IS IMPORTANTE TO CHANGE INFORMATIONS WITH*         
* THE USER AND IN THE PSEUDO CONVERSATION METHOD.             *         
***************************************************************         
                                                                        
 0300-SEND-MAP.                                                         
                                                                        
     EXEC CICS                                                          
         SEND MAP('SELLMP') MAPSET('SELLMS') ERASE                      
     END-EXEC.                                                          
                                                                        
***************************************************************         
* 0310-MOVE-SPACE                                             *         
*                                                             *         
* IT MOVE SPACE TO THE MAP'S VARIABLES. IT IS IMPORTANTE TO   *         
* VERIFY IF ANY INFORMATION WAS INSERT IN IT.                 *         
***************************************************************         
                                                                        
 0310-MOVE-SPACE.                                                       
                                                                        
     MOVE SPACE TO CLIIDI                                               
     MOVE SPACE TO FNUMI                                                
     MOVE SPACE TO PASSN.                                               
                                                                        
***************************************************************         
* 0400-RETURN-CICS.                                           *         
*                                                             *         
* RETURN LETS THE PROGRAM FREE TO RECEIVE OTHER INFORMATIONS  *         
* FROM ANOTHER USERS.                                         *         
* THE COMMUNICATION-AREA IS USED TO SEND INFORMATION BETWEEN  *         
* MAPS.                                                       *         
***************************************************************         
                                                                        
 0400-RETURN-CICS.                                                      
                                                                        
     EXEC CICS                                                          
         RETURN TRANSID ('SEL1')                                        
         COMMAREA(WS-COMMAREA)                                          
     END-EXEC.                                                          
                                                                        
***************************************************************         
* 0500-RECEIVE-MAP.                                           *         
*                                                             *         
* IT RECEIVES THE USER INFORMATION TO BE PROCESSED            *         
***************************************************************         
                                                                        
 0500-RECEIVE-MAP.                                                      
                                                                        
     EXEC CICS                                                          
         RECEIVE MAP('SELLMP') MAPSET('SELLMS')                         
     END-EXEC.                                                          
                                                                        
***************************************************************         
* 0510-VERIFY-EIBAID                                          *         
*                                                             *         
* IT CHECKS IF THE USER PRESS ANY FKEY WHICH IS REALATED WITH *         
* ANOTHER MAP OR FUNCTION.                                    *         
***************************************************************         
                                                                        
 0510-VERIFY-EIBAID.                                                    
                                                                        
     EVALUATE EIBAID                                                    
        WHEN DFHPF3                                                     
                                                                        
            EXEC CICS XCTL                                              
               PROGRAM('LOGIN')                                         
               COMMAREA(WS-COMMAREA)                                    
               LENGTH(12)                                               
            END-EXEC                                                    
                                                                        
        WHEN DFHPF4                                                     
                                                                        
            EXEC CICS XCTL                                              
               PROGRAM('SRCHFLY')                                       
               COMMAREA(WS-COMMAREA)                                    
               LENGTH(12)                                               
            END-EXEC                                                    
                                                                        
        WHEN DFHPF5                                                     
                                                                        
            EXEC CICS XCTL                                              
               PROGRAM('SRCHTKT')                                       
               COMMAREA(WS-COMMAREA)                                    
               LENGTH(12)                                               
            END-EXEC                                                    
                                                                        
        WHEN DFHPF6                                                     
                                                                        
            MOVE 'THIS IS THE CURRENT MAP' TO MSG1O                     
                                                                        
        WHEN DFHPF7                                                     
                                                                        
            MOVE 'THIS MAP IS NOT READY YET' TO MSG1O                   
                                                                        
        WHEN DFHPF10                                                    
                                                                        
            MOVE 'THIS IS THE CURRENT FUNCTION' TO MSG1O                
                                                                        
        WHEN DFHPF12                                                    
                                                                        
            IF WS-FLAG-MOUV = 'Y'                                       
                                                                        
               MOVE CLIIDI TO WS-CLIID                                  
               MOVE FNUMI TO WS-FNUM                                    
               MOVE FDATEI TO WS-FDATE                                  
               MOVE SDAIRI TO WS-DAIR                                   
               MOVE SLAIRI TO WS-LAIR                                   
               MOVE PASSNI TO WS-PASSN                                  
               MOVE SPRICEI TO WS-PRICE                                 
               MOVE STPRICEI TO WS-TPRICE                               
                                                                        
               EXEC CICS XCTL                                           
                  PROGRAM('SELLCOB2')                                   
                  COMMAREA(WS-COMMAREA)                                 
                  LENGTH(66)                                            
               END-EXEC                                                 
                                                                        
            ELSE                                                        
                                                                        
               MOVE 'YOU NEED TO MAKE A VAIBLE REASEARC BEFORE GO       
                    TO THE SELL SCREEN' TO MSG1O                        
                                                                        
            END-IF                                                      
                                                                        
     END-EVALUATE.                                                      
                                                                        
*************************************************************           
* 0600-PROCESS-DATA                                         *           
*                                                           *           
* THE PROGRAM GET THE INFORMATION FROM THE TABLE FLIGHT AND *           
* PASSENGERS                                                *           
*************************************************************           
                                                                        
 0600-PROCESS-DATA.                                                     
                                                                        
     MOVE CLIIDI TO PA-CLIENTID                                         
     MOVE FNUMI TO FLIGHTNUM                                            
     MOVE FDATEI TO FLIGHTDATE                                          
                                                                        
     EXEC SQL                                                           
         SELECT FIRSTNAME, LASTNAME                                     
         INTO :PA-FIRSTNAME_TEXT, : PA-LASTNAME_TEXT                    
         FROM PASSENGERS                                                
         WHERE CLIENTID = :PA-CLIENTID                                  
     END-EXEC                                                           
                                                                        
     EVALUATE SQLCODE                                                   
                                                                        
        WHEN 0                                                          
                                                                        
            CONTINUE                                                    
                                                                        
        WHEN 100                                                        
                                                                        
            MOVE 'THIS PASSENGER DOES NOT EXIST' TO MSG1O               
            MOVE 'N' TO WS-FLAG-MOUV                                    
                                                                        
        WHEN OTHER                                                      
                                                                        
            MOVE 'Y' TO WS-FLAG                                         
            MOVE 'N' TO WS-FLAG-MOUV                                    
                                                                        
            MOVE 'THERE WAS A ERROR IN THE RESEARCH PROCESS' TO         
                                   MSG1O                                
           MOVE 'CONTACT THE IT DEPARTEMENT AND INFORM THIS CODE:'      
                                 TO MSG20                               
                                                                        
            MOVE SQLCODE TO MSG2O(50:5)                                 
            MOVE 'AND' TO MSG2O(57:3)                                   
            MOVE SQLSTATE TO MSG2O(62:5)                                
                                                                        
     END-EVALUATE                                                       
                                                                        
     IF WS-FLAG = 'N'                                                   
        EXEC SQL                                                        
            SELECT FLIGHTID, DEPTIME, ARRTIME, AIRPORTDEP,              
                   AIRPORTARR                                           
            INTO :FLIGHTID, :DEPTIME, :ARRTIME, :AIRPORTDEP,            
                 :AIRPORTARR                                            
            FROM FLIGHT                                                 
            WHERE FLIGHTDATE = :FLIGHTDATE AND FLIGHTNUM =              
                               :FLIGHTNUM                               
        END-EXEC                                                        
                                                                        
        EVALUATE SQLCODE                                                
                                                                        
            WHEN 0                                                      
                                                                        
                CONTINUE                                                
                                                                        
            WHEN 100                                                    
                                                                        
                MOVE 'THIS FLIGHT DOES NOT EXIST' TO MSG1O              
                MOVE 'N' TO WS-FLAG-MOUV                                
                                                                        
            WHEN OTHER                                                  
                                                                        
                MOVE 'Y' TO WS-FLAG                                     
                MOVE 'N' TO WS-FLAG-MOUV                                
                                                                        
               MOVE 'THERE WAS A ERROR IN THE RESEARCH PROCESS' TO      
                                   MSG1O                                
           MOVE 'CONTACT THE IT DEPARTEMENT AND INFORM THIS CODE:'      
                                 TO MSG20                               
                                                                        
                MOVE SQLCODE TO MSG2O(50:5)                             
                MOVE 'AND' TO MSG2O(57:3)                               
                MOVE SQLSTATE TO MSG2O(62:5)                            
                                                                        
         END-EVALUATE                                                   
     END-IF                                                             
                                                                        
     IF WS-FLAG = 'N'                                                   
                                                                        
* IT WILL BE BETTER CALL A PROGRAM TO CALCULATE THE PRICE               
* BUT THIS PROGRAM IS NOT ALREADY YET                                   
                                                                        
         MOVE 'Y' TO WS-FLAG-MOUV                                       
         MOVE 120.99 TO WS-PRICEV                                        
         COMPUTE WS-TOTPRICE = WS-PRICEV * PASSNI                        
                           
         MOVE FLIGHTID TO WS-FLIGHTID                                                               
         MOVE FNUMI TO SFNUMO                                           
         MOVE FDATE TO SFDATEO                                          
         MOVE DEPTIME TO SDTIMEO                                        
         MOVE ARRTIME TO SLTIMEO                                        
         MOVE AIRPORTDEP TO SDAIRO                                      
         MOVE AIRPORTARR TO SLAIRO                                      
         MOVE EDIT-PRICE1 TO SPRICEO                                       
         MOVE EDIT-PRICE TO STPRICEO                                    
                                                                        
     END-IF.                                                            
                                                                        
****************************************************************        
* 0610-VERIFY-SPACE                                            *        
*                                                              *        
* IT VERIFY IF ALL DATA WAS INSERT IN THE SELL MAP TO LINK     *        
* CLIENT AND FLIGHT                                            *        
****************************************************************        
                                                                        
 0610-VERIFY-SPACE.                                                     
                                                                        
     IF CLIIDO IS NOT NUMERIC OR CLIENTID = 0                           
        MOVE 'Y' TO WS-FLAG                                             
        MOVE 'YOU MUST INSERT A NUMBER IN THE CLIENTID' TO MSG1O        
     ELSE                                                               
     IF FNUMO = SPACE                                                   
        MOVE 'Y' TO WS-FLAG                                             
        MOVE 'YOU MUST INSERT A CORRECT FIGHT NUMBER' TO MSG1O          
     ELSE                                                               
     IF FDATEO(1:4) IS NOT NUMERIC OR FDATEO(6:2) IS NOT NUMERIC        
        OR FDATEO(9:2) IS NOT NUMERIC OR FFDATEO(5:1) NOT = '-' OR      
        FDATEO(8:1) NOT = '-'                                           
                                                                        
        MOVE 'Y' TO WS-FLAG                                             
        MOVE 'THE CORRECT DATA FORMAT IS: YYYY-MM-DD' TO MSG1O          
                                                                        
     ELSE                                                               
     IF PASSNO IS NOT NUMERIC OR PASSNO = 0                             
                                                                        
        MOVE 'Y' TO WS-FLAG                                             
        MOVE 'YOU MUST INSERT A NUMBER IN THE NUMBER OF CLIENTS'        
                        TO MSG1O                                        
     END-IF.

plan.approach: The CICS pseudo-conversational program SELLCOB1 is restructured as a single stateless REST endpoint (POST /api/sell/search). The two-screen CICS conversation (SELLMP → SELLCOB2) becomes a single HTTP request/response cycle: the client sends all validated inputs and receives fully computed pricing data ready to feed into a subsequent SELLCOB2-equivalent endpoint. CICS facilities (ASKTIME, FORMATTIME, SEND/RECEIVE MAP, RETURN TRANSID, XCTL) are replaced by Spring MVC mechanics and Java standard library calls. All three DB2 SELECT statements are mapped to JPA repository methods. The hard-coded price (120.99) is externalised to application.properties.
patterns_used: Global Exception Handler (@RestControllerAdvice) mirroring COBOL SQLCODE WHEN OTHER branches
Strategy / Configuration pattern (AppProperties for externalised base price)
plan.sql_strategy: Each EXEC SQL SELECT is replaced by a Spring Data JPA repository method. The PASSENGERS SELECT (WHERE CLIENTID = ?) maps to the inherited JpaRepository.findById(Long). The FLIGHT SELECT (WHERE FLIGHTDATE = ? AND FLIGHTNUM = ?) maps to a custom @Query method FlightRepository.findByFlightNumAndFlightDate(). SQLCODE 0 (found) is the happy path; SQLCODE 100 (not found) is represented by Optional.isEmpty() and throws a typed domain exception; SQLCODE OTHER maps to the global @ExceptionHandler(Exception.class) catch-all that returns HTTP 500 with the COBOL error-message text.
plan.call_strategy: The CICS XCTL PROGRAM('SELLCOB2') call (triggered by PF12 when WS-FLAG-MOUV='Y') is not implemented in this service because SELLCOB2 is a separate program. Instead, the response DTO includes flightId and all COMMAREA fields so that a REST client can immediately invoke a future /api/sell/confirm endpoint (SELLCOB2 equivalent) with those values. The XCTL calls to LOGIN, SRCHFLY, and SRCHTKT (PF3/PF4/PF5) represent navigation that is handled client-side in a REST architecture.
